column1: # Individuals excluded from every count: the 12 Baker et al. 2025 BAMs with essentially no data (empty_bams_12.tsv) and two individuals with signs of contamination (male-like chrZ heterozygosity under female coverage calls, chrZ coverage above every male, and the extreme positions on autosomal PC2). Analyses run before the exclusion received only missing genotypes from the 12 and include the two.
